Markdown editor browser dependencies (vendored locally)

- marked 18.1.1 — MIT license; see MARKED-LICENSE.txt
- DOMPurify 3.4.17 — Apache License 2.0 or Mozilla Public License 2.0; see the DOMPURIFY license files

User-authored Markdown is parsed in the browser and sanitized with DOMPurify before being inserted into the preview.
